{"_meta":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo":{"description":"Context7 provides up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.","icons":[{"mimeType":"image/svg+xml","sizes":["any"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.svg"},{"mimeType":"image/png","sizes":["512x512"],"src":"https://context7.com/context7-icon-green.png"}],"name":"Context7","title":"Context7","version":"4.4.2","websiteUrl":"https://context7.com"}},"content":[{"text":"### Port and train spawning\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/execution/PortExecution.ts\n\nPortExecution.ts and TrainStationExecution.ts (packages/engine/src/execution/) implement port/train spawning: a port spawns a TrainStationExecution when a Factory is within trainStationMaxRange, and the station spawns trains on a 10-tick cooldown if its rail cluster has a trade destination.\n\n```typescript\n  createStation(): void {\n    const nearbyFactory = this.mg.hasUnitNearby(\n      this.port.tile()!,\n      this.mg.config().trainStationMaxRange(),\n      UnitType.Factory,\n    );\n    if (nearbyFactory) {\n      this.mg.addExecution(new TrainStationExecution(this.port));\n    }\n  }\n```\n\n--------------------------------\n\n### EngineConfig tradeShipSpawnRate and trainSpawnRate\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/packages/engine/src/configuration/EngineConfig.ts\n\nDefines the probability (as 1-in-N rate) for trade ships and trains to spawn, factoring in fleet saturation, factory/port counts, rejection pity timers, and small-economy boosts. EngineConfig extends Config (the default-config base).\n\n```typescript\n  trainSpawnRate(numPlayerFactories: number, numTrainUnits: number): number {\n    const rate = (numPlayerFactories + 10) * 15;\n    const boost = this.smallEconomySpawnBoost(numPlayerFactories);\n    return Math.max(\n      1,\n      Math.floor(rate / (this.trainSaturation(numTrainUnits) * boost)),\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Probability of trade ship spawn = 1 / tradeShipSpawnRate\n  tradeShipSpawnRate(\n    tradeShipSpawnRejections: number,\n    numTradeShips: number,\n    playerPortLevels: number,\n  ): number {\n    const rejectionModifier = 1 / (tradeShipSpawnRejections + 1);\n    const boost = this.smallEconomySpawnBoost(playerPortLevels);\n    const base = 100 / (boost * boost);\n    return Math.max(\n      1,\n      Math.floor(\n        (base * rejectionModifier) / this.tradeShipSaturation(numTradeShips),\n      ),\n    );\n  }\n```\n\n### Tooling changes the move forces\n\nSource: https://github.com/openfrontio/openfrontio/blob/main/docs/EnginePackageSplit.md\n\n| File                                                                | Change                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |\n| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |\n| `package.json`                                                      | `\"workspaces\": [\"packages/*\"]`; root keeps its dependencies. Lockfile regenerated with `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`                                                                                                                        |\n| `packages/*/package.json`                                           | `name`, `\"private\": true`, `\"type\": \"module\"`, `\"exports\": {\"./*\": \"./src/*.ts\"}`, and the package's own deps (`engine-api`: `zod`, `jose`, `@openfront/zbin`; `shared`: adds `dompurify`, `nanoid`, `@openfront/engine-api`; `engine`: `@openfront/engine-api`) |\n| `tsconfig.base.json` (new)                                          | Today's compiler options plus `paths` for `resources/*`.
